criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame rendered with light type on a dark sky; 2, 4 and 7 near the 10. Slide 5 a peg-fingered hand holding a zero thickness sheet, a mid grey sleeve; slide 8 game character figures and a black chair block; slide 9 walker the largest light mass; slide 3 middle screens alias; slide 6 desk small; slide 4 the desk top brighter than the page; slide 7 a mottled mass behind the kicker. The outdoor pool and seam barely read.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: A filmstrip; one desk in one material on 8 of 9; the walk a spine and the inlay changes state; the camera move works; value holds dark with no strobe.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; the clock reads 6:30; 'first-ever' always attributed; illustrations labelled. c18 is a medium confidence absence; slide 3's right columns run off the frame so 79 can't be checked by eye.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: The body, framework, scale, existing document and dated events are there; who decides honestly unnamed; what changes for a student stays general; no form URL.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns a swipe, 2 pays, 4 a real turn; 5 re-reads rules; 8 restates 6's date; the close lands on an invitation rather than the turn.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register; flat and institutional; the illustration disclaimer recurs on four frames.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh topic; a third last-light staged world in four days; one paver per day repeats no. 46; screen-bearing furniture echoes no. 47.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild 5, 8 and 9 so no figure is read up close, and light the outdoor frames with a real raking pool so the lawn falls to black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Peg-fingered hand, a zero thickness sheet floating over the edge, a mid grey sleeve filling the right third.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Both hands on the keys cropped at the wrist, a dark sleeve, the sheet flat on the desk with a contact shadow.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Game character figures, cropped right-hand figures, a black chair-back block in the lower left.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera up and right of the hero desk so its lit top replaces the block; rows rim lit from the window as silhouettes.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The low detail walker is the biggest light mass; the lawn evenly lit.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: The desk and its paver the only pool; the walker in near silhouette with a west rim and a long shadow.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Middle screens alias; right columns off the frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Far screens toward black with distance; pull back so all rows sit inside with a dark margin.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Desk small at the left; flat lawn of repeated tufts; labels unanchored.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera along the walk so the desk stands at the right third; leader ticks to the inlays.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A square-on product shot; the desk top brighter than the page; a stray arc in the bottom band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rake the key so the top falls off; crop upward so the bottom band leaves the frame.
